title: Coastal Town Shops and Angled Park
sourceTitle: Pokémon Pokopia~EASY COASTAL TOWN HABITAT BUILDING SHOPS & ANGLED TOWN PARK~STARTER DESIGN #pokopia
creator: HorribleGaming
summary: A bright coastal town habitat with two connected shopfronts, layered tiled roofs, flower boxes, vine-covered walls, a balcony, broad stone steps, and a compact angled park edge.
publicNotes:
## Build Notes

HorribleGaming's coastal town habitat turns a small raised block into a compact seaside shopping street. Two connected facades mix pale siding, brickwork, storefront windows, layered roofs, awnings, flower boxes, and climbing vines, while the balcony and side stairs give the build a convincing second level.

The lower plaza is what makes the composition feel like a town rather than a single house. Broad stone steps, paired streetlights, waterfront-style rope posts, a small seating nook, and the angled park edge create a clean public entrance without crowding the shopfronts.
automationNotes: Headless YouTube capture rejected repeated blank/player-shell screenshots at 2s, 4s, and 6s.
The curator supplied a clean full-build screenshot showing the finished coastal town habitat.
Item inference was narrowed to catalog matches that are visually supported by the manual hero frame.
